name: Weekend album
summary: Curate a weekend's photo dump into an album where everyone shows up at least twice, then play it as a story with captions from the chat.
useWhen: after a trip or weekend with lots of photos: 'make an album', 'pick the best ones from the dump'
a recap of the weekend for the chat
dontUseWhen: voting on one best photo (use a poll or caption contest)
a story of the chat's messages (use wrapped)

params.title: card title
params.album: album name on the story cover
params.kept: appearances per friend among photos already kept
params.photos: up to 15 x {scene, people, when, order, caption, verdict: pick|open|reject, why}
